options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (session count, date range, first and last close with the change, highest high and lowest low, sessions not plotted).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for prices (tooltips, accessible names, table, summary, ticks).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Ids of hidden moving averages (legend toggles).

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash?; axisColor?; lineWidth?; markerSize?; cornerRadius?; barRadius?; cellRadius?; sliceRadius?; boxRadius?; swatchRadius?; tooltipRadius?; controlRadius?; lineJoin?; areaOpacity?; gradient?; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair and tooltip at the same column (session index) when one is hovered or focused. Use charts with the same sessions.

options.name: data
options.description: Sessions: { date: PlainDate (strictly increasing); open, high, low, close: finite numbers (high >= open, close, low; low <= open, close); volume?: number >= 0 }. At most 20,000.

options.name: type
options.description: Candles (hollow when rising, filled when falling) or OHLC bars (falling bars dashed).

options.name: volume
options.description: Volume pane below the prices when the data has volume.

options.name: movingAverages
options.description: Up to 4 simple moving averages of the close: { period: 2-250 sessions; id?: string (default "ma<period>"); label?: string; color?: 1-8; style?: ChartSeriesStyle }.

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Business calendar (createBusinessCalendar from @absoluteui/components/business-calendar): the axis counts trading days only, so weekends and holidays take no space; sessions on non-working days are not plotted and are listed in the summary. Without it the axis is a calendar-day axis with gaps.

options.name: priceAxis
options.description: Price axis: { label?, min?, max?, tickCount? (2-20) }.

options.name: volumeFormat
options.description: Volume format (tooltips, table, pane label). Default compact notation.

options.name: zoom
options.description: Zoom and pan over time: toolbar buttons, + / - / 0 keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag to pan, Shift + drag to select.

options.name: zoomRange
options.description: Visible axis range { from, to } in axis positions (trading-day or day index from the first session); null shows everything.

options.name: legend
options.description: Legend of the moving averages (toggle buttons): auto shows it when there is at least one average, show always, hide never.

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback (date, open, high, low, close, volume, and every moving average): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

options.name: patterns
options.description: Dash patterns on the moving averages (WCAG 1.4.1). Candles are always hollow (rising) or filled (falling). Forced-colors mode always shows them.

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: crosshair
options.description: Crosshair lines (time and price) on the hovered or focused session.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, date, and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the time axis and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same mark.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide an item programmatically (no event).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, timers, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: CandlestickChartPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A candle was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused candle. label is the date, column the session index, value the formatted close.

events.name: aui-series-toggle
events.detail: CandlestickChartSeriesToggleDetail: { id: string; visible: boolean; hidden: string[] }
events.description: A moving average was shown or hidden from the legend.

events.name: aui-zoom
events.detail: CandlestickChartZoomDetail: { x: ChartZoomRange | null; y: null; reason: 'button' | 'keyboard' | 'wheel' | 'pan' | 'select' | 'reset' }
events.description: The visible range changed (also announced politely).

cssClasses.name: aui-candlestick-chart
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title, description, and the toolbar (zoom buttons).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip--custom / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-row
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused mark carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty / __summary
cssClasses.description: Empty state text and the hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-candlestick-chart__candles / __candle / __candle--up / __candle--down
cssClasses.description: Candles (focusable marks): hollow rising, filled falling.

cssClasses.name: aui-candlestick-chart__bar / __bar--up / __bar--down
cssClasses.description: OHLC bars (type ohlc); falling bars dashed.
